scripts.text: [Sratos]
Hello, dear customer who walked in, let's hope for a miracle today.
scripts.translation: 歡迎光臨，親愛的顧客。希望今天能有奇蹟發生。

scripts.text: How can I help you?
Enhance the equipment's grade.
Exchange Etel items
What is Grade Enhancement?
[Sratos]
Our customer. You want to enhance the grade of equipment.
scripts.translation: 顧客，想提升裝備等級嗎？

scripts.text: It is not easy to move the magical power of jewels.
scripts.translation: 寶石中的魔力可不容易轉移。

scripts.text: [Sratos]
Magical power can explode on the spot.
Then the weapon that will inherit the magical power also explodes!
scripts.translation: 繼承這股魔力的武器也會跟著炸燬！

scripts.text: I'll still do it!
I'll think about it.
[Sratos]
I wish good luck to our courageous customers!
[Sratos]
Whenever you have the courage to challenge, please come back.
scripts.translation: 只要有勇氣挑戰，隨時歡迎回來。

scripts.text: [Sratos]
These are jewels used to enhance grades.
scripts.translation: 這些是用於提升裝備等級的寶石。

scripts.text: Etel Dust, the jewels that will be the base, and if you give me a small fee I'll exchange it for Etel jewels.
scripts.translation: 給我以太粉塵和作為基底的寶石，再付一點手續費，我就能幫你換成以太寶石。

scripts.text: [Sratos]
Occasionally, unstable jewels with a lot of pure magical power are found.
scripts.translation: 偶爾會發現魔力純度很高、卻不穩定的寶石。

scripts.text: We call these etheric gems, right?
scripts.translation: 我們把它們叫作以太寶石，對吧？

scripts.text: [Sratos]
You can transfer the magical power of the etheric gem to other weapons, but of course there is some risk.
scripts.translation: 你可以把以太寶石的魔力轉移到其他武器上，不過當然會有風險。

scripts.text: It's delicate, so if you aren't careful, pop! It will explode.
scripts.translation: 這過程很精細，稍不留神，砰！就會爆炸。

scripts.text: [Sratos]
Anyway, if you use this etheric gem, you can enhance the weapon you are using.
scripts.translation: 總之，使用以太寶石就能提升你正在使用的武器。

scripts.text: Performance gets better. We call this grade enhancement.
scripts.translation: 效能會變得更好。這就叫裝備等級提升。

scripts.text: [Sratos]
You too, wouldn't you be happy if the weapons you love grow one step further?
scripts.translation: 如果你喜愛的武器能更上一層樓，你也會很高興吧？

scripts.text: We are the people who assist it. It's a bit risky, though. ahahaha.
scripts.translation: 我們就是幫你實現這件事的人。雖然有點風險就是了，啊哈哈哈。

scripts.text: [Suribell]
May good luck always be with you!
Welcome to Paramarket's Grade Enhancement Center~
scripts.translation: 歡迎來到帕拉市場的裝備等級提升中心~

scripts.text: Enhance the equipment's grade.
Exchange Etel items
What is Grade Enhancement?
[Suribell]
Do you want to unlock the potential of your favorite equipment?
scripts.translation: 想發掘心愛裝備的潛能嗎？

scripts.text: Explosions may also occur in the process of dealing with magical powers.
scripts.translation: 處理魔力的過程中也可能發生爆炸。

scripts.text: [Suribell]
Still, if you're trying to enhance your grade... !
scripts.translation: 不過，如果你想提升裝備等級...！

scripts.text: I, Suribell, will do my best!
scripts.translation: 我蘇麗貝爾一定會盡全力幫忙！

scripts.text: I'll still do it!
I'll think about it.
[Suribell]
Let's hold hands and have faith! Try clenching your teeth!
scripts.translation: 讓我們牽起手，相信彼此！咬緊牙關試試看！

scripts.text: [Suribell]
Okay! Let's drink a glass of cold water!
[Suribell]
You need etheric gems to enhance grades!
scripts.translation: 提升裝備等級需要以太寶石！

scripts.text: If you combine Etel Dust and jewels to make it, it is fine! An Etel jewel for adventurers is complete!
scripts.translation: 把以太粉塵和寶石組合起來就行！冒險者專用的以太寶石就完成了！

scripts.text: Would you like to combine jewels and Etel Dust?
scripts.translation: 要組合寶石和以太粉塵嗎？

scripts.text: [Suribell]
Occasionally, unstable jewels with a lot of pure magical power are found.
scripts.translation: 偶爾會發現魔力純度很高、卻不穩定的寶石。

scripts.text: I decided to call such gems etheric gems.
scripts.translation: 我決定把這種寶石稱為以太寶石。

scripts.text: Who? I am Suribell!
[Suribell]
The magical power of etheric gems sometimes awakens the hidden potential of equipment.
scripts.translation: 以太寶石的魔力有時會喚醒裝備隱藏的潛能。

scripts.text: We call it grade enhancement because it goes up one tier!
scripts.translation: 因為裝備能提升一個階級，所以我們稱之為等級提升！

scripts.text: [Suribell]
The adventurer may have a potential that is unknown to him.
scripts.translation: 冒險者自身也可能擁有未知的潛能。

scripts.text: There is a risk that it can be destroyed if done wrong, but try it with faith!
scripts.translation: 操作不當可能導致裝備損毀，但請懷著信心試試吧！
